coverage.note: A bounded selection; not a complete channel catalogue.
Song clip, not a full film.
Exact-title searches recovered primary uploader metadata for Sidharth TV. The network website lists its official channel. Alternate uploads were excluded; this is not a complete channel inventory.
New Kabula Barabula Searching Laila and Inspector Sana candidates remain held because their uploader was not confirmed. The existing DAMaN listing was not counted as a new addition.
Love Station was a 15-minute abridgement on Tarang TV. Searches for Tu Mo Love Story, Agastya and Jaga Hatare Pagha did not establish a full upload. Other results were short clips, not full films.
Full-film searches, including Sindura Bindu, recovered the song Na Jaa Radhika on Saregama Regional. It was excluded from the full-film count.
Searches returned Hindi material and an explicitly Bengali-dubbed Something Something listing. These were excluded from the Odia collection.
The search did not establish an exact official Odia full-film upload. This does not establish that none exists.

55 visible title links on language catalogue inspected as discovery inventory; 10 exact title pages checked and added. Remaining entries require individual language/version/format checks. Catalogue combines Odia productions with dubbed imports; not a count of original Odia cinema.
Official collection and indexed title evidence checked. One exact title route added. Language catalogue timed out; no complete enumeration.
Biswaprakash exact listing rechecked; region availability unresolved. Search did not establish a complete Odia catalogue.
Official movies page returned navigation/login shell only. No title-specific routes promoted from old publicity.
Official homepage returned shell only. Full catalogue not enumerated.
Official app and YouTube promotional presence found. No current exact full-film playback routes verified; trailers and streaming announcements are not counted as full films.

featured.reason: A public-health drama recognised as Best Odia Film at the 70th National Film Awards, with questions of care and representation explored in our companion article.
Susant Misra’s film offers another filmmaking voice: it received Best Feature Film in Oriya recognition for 1999 at the 47th National Film Awards.
